requirement.evidence: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
requirement.note: Prohibition definition and enforcement by Division of Housing or aggrieved private citizen in Municipal Court are both stated.

effective_date.evidence: This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon passage and publication as provided by law.
effective_date.note: Adopted Jul 9, 2025, but effect depends on publication, whose date is not stated; 2025-07-09 is an approximation.

status.note: Adopted and presented as current; no repeal or amendment appears. Effect upon publication is not confirmed, but in_force is reasonable.

citation.evidence: ORDINANCE AMENDING AND SUPPLEMENTING CHAPTER 158 (RENT INCREASES) OF THE HOBOKEN CITY CODE BY ADDING A NEW SECTION 158-2, ENTITLED “PROHIBITION AGAINST ALGORITHMIC RENT-FIXING IN THE RENTAL HOUSING MARKET”
